categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Convert Semiconductor Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research and development, and sales of power semiconductors and power ICs, along with providing related technical services. Its product portfolio includes power devices such as planar MOSFETs, trench MOSFETs, superjunction MOSFETs, and SiC MOSFETs, as well as power ICs including PWM controllers and gate drivers. The company also offers chip design and process development services, focusing on high-reliability applications and industrial control sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor technologies including planar MOSFET, trench MOSFET, superjunction MOSFET, and third-generation semiconductor materials like silicon carbide (SiC). It has developed proprietary technologies such as high-voltage MOSFET minority carrier lifetime control, novel composite terminal structures, and short-channel SiC MOSFET manufacturing techniques. The company operates under a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to foundries, focusing its internal capabilities on chip design, process optimization, and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known chip design companies, solution providers, and clients in high-reliability fields such as industrial power supplies, automotive electronics, and renewable energy sectors. The company serves over 600 customers, with significant penetration in industrial control, new energy vehicles, charging stations, and high-reliability power modules. Its products are widely applied in LED lighting, smart appliances, power adapters, motor drives, and energy storage systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with domestic sales accounting for the vast majority of revenue. It also has limited export sales. Its headquarters and main operations are located in Zhangjiagang City, Jiangsu Province, with subsidiaries in Xi'an, Shanghai, and other locations in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Convert Semiconductor operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on upstream design and R&D of power semiconductor chips and power ICs. It outsources midstream wafer fabrication and downstream packaging and testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors. This model allows the company to concentrate on core technology development and product innovation while relying on external partners for manufacturing and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment, increasing R&D expenses by over 60% in 2024. Strategic priorities include expanding product lines in power devices and power ICs, advancing third-generation semiconductor technologies such as SiC MOSFETs, and enhancing high-reliability and industrial control applications. It aims to build comprehensive design platforms, optimize manufacturing processes, and develop series products covering a wide voltage and current range. Talent acquisition and training are also key components of its R&D strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor products including power devices and power ICs. The company also earns income from providing technical services such as chip design and process development. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to key customers and supplemented by a buyout distribution model. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on product sales and related technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the power semiconductor market against global leaders such as Infineon, ON Semiconductor, STMicroelectronics, and domestic competitors like Hua Micro and Silan Microelectronics. While international brands dominate the high-end market, the company is positioned as a growing domestic player with advanced proprietary technologies and a broad product portfolio. It is recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise, aiming to strengthen its market share through innovation and localization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 130 million, a 39% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 97 million. Despite the short-term financial setbacks due to market conditions and increased R&D and marketing expenses, the company has shown a consistent increase in R&D investment and expanded its product offerings. Total assets were around RMB 965 million with equity of approximately RMB 907 million at year-end 2024. The company is in a growth and investment phase, focusing on long-term competitiveness.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Convert Semiconductor emphasizes its independent innovation capabilities, comprehensive product matrix covering silicon and silicon carbide power devices, and high-performance power ICs tailored for high-reliability and industrial applications. Its proprietary technologies achieve international advanced levels in key areas such as minority carrier lifetime control and composite terminal structures. The company offers customers energy-efficient, high-reliability semiconductor solutions that support domestic substitution of imported products, contributing to China's semiconductor self-sufficiency goals.
